main.title: Home Interior
main.short: Complete interior decoration for modern homes and apartments.
main.description: Full-home interior decoration covering layout planning, storage, wall treatments, false ceiling, lighting and furniture, delivered as one coordinated project.
benefits: One team for planning, execution and finishing
Storage designed around how your family lives
Material choices suited to Howrah's humid climate

main.title: Living Room
main.short: Elegant living spaces designed for comfort and style.
main.description: TV units, feature walls, seating layouts, display niches and layered lighting that make the first room guests see feel considered and calm.
benefits: Statement TV and feature wall design

main.title: Bedroom
main.short: Calm, beautiful and personalized bedroom interiors.
main.description: Wardrobes, dressing units, headboard panelling, study corners and soft lighting designed for rest, with finishes chosen for daily use.

main.title: Modular Kitchen
main.short: Smart, stylish and functional kitchen interiors.

benefits: L, U, parallel and island layouts
main.suitable: Apartments, houses, small kitchens needing more storage

main.title: Office Interior
main.short: Professional interiors designed for productive workspaces.

main.title: Commercial Interior
